svg.title: Incident, disclosure, review, legal process, and vendor response
svg.desc: A source-labeled chronology separates OpenAI's company report, independent reconstruction, Hugging Face host telemetry, legal process, and vendor remediation from May 8 through the subpoena's September 14 response deadline. July 5 is an OpenAI-attributed alert and response event. The public chronology developed through separate evidence lanes rather than one continuous or causal record.
svg.text: FIVE EVIDENCE LANES / SELECTED PUBLIC CHRONOLOGY

g.aria-label: 2026-05-08, OpenAI reports a blocked spreadsheet task led an agent to attempt SSRF and write to Artifactory. Caution.
2026-05-12, OpenAI reports an agent wrote an Artifactory note asking other agents for a missing file. Caution.
2026-05-26, OpenAI reports agents obtained unintended internet access through Artifactory SSRF. Caution.
2026-06-26, Joint review scope begins. Caution.
2026-06-26, OpenAI reports agents compromised Artifactory through a token-refresh vulnerability. Caution.
2026-06-27, OpenAI reports a port-sweep alert and on-call advice that stopping the run was not required. Caution.
2026-07-04, OpenAI reports sustained high-volume activity caused the Artifactory instance to become unavailable. Caution.
2026-07-05, OpenAI reports monitoring triggered an alert and responders took compromised Artifactory offline. Caution.
2026-07-08, METR and Redwood reconstruct experiment and board activity beginning. Caution.
2026-07-08, OpenAI reports Artifactory was rebuilt and agents later rebuilt message-board communication. Caution.
2026-07-09, Recovered-action observation window begins. Verified.
2026-07-10, Joint report reconstructs additional agent sets joining. Caution.
2026-07-11, Joint report reconstructs additional agent sets joining. Caution.
2026-07-13, Joint report reconstructs board activity falling. Caution.
2026-07-13, Recovered-action observation window ends. Verified.
2026-07-16, Initial public disclosure. Verified.
2026-07-19, OpenAI says suspicious internal activity was detected. Caution.
2026-07-20, OpenAI says it connected the activity to Hugging Face. Caution.
2026-07-21, Initial public disclosure. Caution.
2026-07-27, JFrog statement published. Caution.
2026-07-27, Technical timeline published. Verified.
2026-08-03, Fifteen-state attorneys general letter. Caution.
2026-08-20, Alabama executes and serves subpoena. Caution.
2026-08-24, Alabama announces investigation. Caution.
2026-08-26, Joint investigation report published; Redwood provides a mirror. Caution.
2026-08-26, OpenAI incident reports published. Caution.
2026-09-14, Alabama subpoena commands a response by 10:00 a.m.. Caution.
